rationale.A: Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu with ~260 m in traffic incl. tram rails, then Paciuksenkatu and Kuusisaarentie side paths; 11 lights
rationale.B: Central Park via Auroransilta and Ratsastie, then Kuusisaarentie side path; no traffic, 4 lights
rationale.C: Same Central Park route as B via quiet Hammarskjöldintie; fewest unsignalled crossings; 4 lights
rationale.D: Same as A via Meilahdentie; 10 lights
rationale.E: Mississipinraitti shore, but Eino Leinon katu tram in traffic and long Paciuksenkatu side path; 9 lights
rationale.F: Same as C with Kallio side streets at the start and least Helsinginkatu side path; 3 lights, +2 min
rationale.G: Same Central Park route as B/C; 5 lights
rationale.H: Central Park then Tilkka streets and paths, more walking; +9 min

notes: All routes share the 2.2 km Kuusisaarentie side path. B/C/F/G are one Central Park route with small start variations. C removes A's carriageway riding on Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu and saves 7 lights for +1 min, so it covers both cards. F is marginally calmer and saves 1 more light, which is noise.
